许默盯着光幕上的文字，标定淡然。

“合作可以，但是规矩得定下来。”

信息发送的瞬间，方芸紧张的过来，脸色煞白。

“有人在区域频道克隆了你的ID！完全一样的头像和名字，发了个假竞拍链接，已经有三个散人把幸存点转过去了！”

许默瞳孔骤然收缩。

他想不到对方用的是什么方法，但这不重要。

在永恒领域，和平只是表象，信誉就是命！

借他的名头骗物资，狗东西，找死！

“把他找出来。”

方芸深吸一口气。

“哪那么容易！现在对方隐匿了自己的名字，我们根本没法再找了！”

这确实让许默有些气极，但现在不是上头的时候。

“先别管，等会儿再看！”

大区群里，几个人对许默进行了长达几十分钟的文字问候。

但许默发现受害者人数并没有变多。

这很有可能是骗子的手段有限，次数有限。

见状，许默截了一个图发送大群：

“这是我这几天的私聊记录，还有交易记录，大伙看看，我什么时候跟他们交易了？”

“你们被骗了，我很难受，我这次可以没人赔偿一份蜂蜜，但下次你们再如此诋毁我，别怪我翻脸！”

这下，群里骂人的几个灭火了。

同时，也开始有人为许墨解释。

“骗子找过我，但我早就跟许大佬交易过，当时我就发现私聊的界面不一样，我都没上当！你们反省一下自己是不是贪便宜才被骗的？”

“哈哈，刚才我就想说来着，但我觉得，跟他们几个浪费理智值有点不值得，现在我站出来告诉告诉你，什么叫自有大儒为我辩经！”

许默此时也接到私聊消息，正是被骗者其中之一。

“哥，我错了，我有眼无珠被骗了，不该连累你，你说那蜂蜜的事儿，是真的吗？”

许默轻哼一声，直接发了一份蜂蜜交易过去。

对方欣喜若狂，大群发言立刻倒戈。

“我错了！不该怪罪许大佬！”

许默微微摇头，看着方芸苦笑了一下。

随后，他把那堆原石掏了出来。

方芸大眼睛一下就瞪起来了。

“这么多，哪来的？”

许默点了点自己的脸。

Xu Mo stared at the words on the light screen, calmly.

"Cooperation is possible, but the rules must be set."

The moment the message was sent, Fang Yun came over nervously, her face turned pale.

"Someone cloned your ID on the regional channel! The exact same avatar and name, and sent a fake bidding link. Three individual people have already transferred their survival points!"

Xu Mo's pupils suddenly shrank.

He couldn't think of what method the other party used, but that didn't matter.

In the eternal realm, peace is just an appearance, and reputation is life!

Use his name to defraud supplies, bullshit, and seek death!

"Find him out."

Fang Yun took a deep breath.

"It's not that easy! Now that the other party has hidden his name, we can't find it anymore!"

This indeed made Xu Mo a little angry, but now was not the time to take the lead.

"Don't worry about it now, we'll see later!"

In the group group, several people exchanged text greetings with Xu Mo for dozens of minutes.

But Schumer found that the number of victims had not increased.

This is most likely because the scammers have limited means and limited times.

Seeing this, Xu Mo took a screenshot and sent it to the group:

"These are my private chat records and transaction records over the past few days. Take a look, when did I trade with them?"

"You were deceived, and I feel very bad. I don't have to pay a share of honey this time, but next time you slander me like this, don't blame me for falling out!"

At this time, some of the cursers in the group put out the fire.

At the same time, people began to explain to Xu Mo.

"Scammers have approached me, but I have already traded with Mr. Xu. At that time, I found that the private chat interface was different, and I was not fooled! Do you think about it, did you get cheated because of being cheap?"

"Haha, I just wanted to say that, but I think it's not worth wasting my rationality with them. Now I stand up and tell you what it means to have a great scholar argue for me!"

Xu Mo also received a private message at this time, and he was one of the deceived people.

"Brother, I was wrong. I was blind and deceived. I shouldn't have got you involved. Is the thing about honey you said true?"

Xu Mo hummed and directly sent a honey transaction.

The other party was ecstatic, and the large group immediately switched sides after speaking.

"I was wrong! Boss Xu should not be blamed!"

Xu Mo shook his head slightly, looked at Fang Yun and smiled bitterly.

Then, he took out the pile of rough stones.

Fang Yun's eyes suddenly widened.

"So many, where did they come from?"

Xu Mo nodded his face.
